title.description: The heading, which also names the Dialog. Without one, the Dialog needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and a blank title does not count.

description.description: Supporting text under the title, which also describes the Dialog.

open.description: Whether the Dialog is open, when the caller controls it.

defaultOpen.description: Whether the Dialog starts open, when it controls itself.

dismissable.description: Whether Escape, an outside press, the trigger, and the built-in close button close the Dialog. When false, the Dialog renders no close button of its own, and only a button in the close slot closes it.

trigger.description: The element that opens the Dialog. Without one, only open or defaultOpen opens it.

backdropClassName.description: A class added to the backdrop beside Mux UI's own.

panelClassName.description: A class added to the dialog panel beside Mux UI's own.

titleClassName.description: A class added to the title beside Mux UI's own.

descriptionClassName.description: A class added to the description beside Mux UI's own.

contentClassName.description: A class added to the content beside Mux UI's own.

actionsClassName.description: A class added to the actions beside Mux UI's own.

closeClassName.description: A class added to the built-in close button beside Mux UI's own.

openChange.description: Reports the Dialog opening or closing. A Dialog that is not dismissable reports no close from Escape, an outside press, or the trigger.
